description: This file defines a React context provider named NotesProvider for managing notes state in a note-taking web application. It includes state definitions, functions for CRUD operations on notes, and context setup for sharing state across components.

methods.name: formatInitialDraft
methods.description: Formats the initial draft data for a note, providing empty strings if the note is null.

methods.name: NotesProvider
methods.description: React component that provides the notes context to its children.

methods.name: useNotesStore
methods.description: Custom hook to access the notes store; must be used within the NotesProvider.
